attributes.board_name: Indiana Behavioral Health and Human Services Licensing Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I (formal programs, incl. accredited home study, from automatically approved sponsors such as NASW, ASWB, NBCC, ACA, AAMFT, AMHCA, APA, ACCME (mental-health related), accredited colleges, government agencies, or Indiana-approved Category I sponsors); Category II self-directed activities (max 20 per cycle)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed less than 12 months: no CE needed for renewal; licensed less than 24 months: 20 hours.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; credits count only in the period earned.
rules.audit_note: Certificates sent only if audited; keep CE records 4 years. Shortfalls must be made up and fined ($100-$500+ schedule).
rules.notes: All BHHS licenses expire April 1 of even years. Board FAQ: at least 20 CEUs per year, at least 10 of them Category I.
